span.p:
every call goes through to the bank core
results cached with a TTL

fail INSTANTLY, do not even try
serve stale cache and SAY SO
let one call through and see

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHY this matters more than it looks:
without a breaker, a dead core costs
a full timeout PER LOOKUP - six reads
means six timeouts, and the brief is
late for every single caller.
With it, degradation costs microseconds.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
served_stale flag propagates all the way
to the agent screen as CORE_DATA_STALE.
An agent seeing old data deserves to
know it is old. (D18)
